messages:
anna_pm: Drafting a narrower "autoretire orchestration" proposal. Key idea: use statistically-significant benchmark regressions (A/B) at tenant granularity before any retire action. If sig-regression detected, spawn a MigrationPlan with configurable cohorts + billing credits. Prefer small first cohort (1%) then scale. Thoughts on thresholds and crediting tiers?
ryan_eng: sounds reasonable. s/"statistically-significant" -> what's our test? t-test on avg score per-request? and how do we handle low-traffic tenants (sparse signals)?
kevin_csm: tiers: self-serve get token credits (e.g., 50k tokens), startup customers get small invoice credits, enterprise gets negotiable account credit. For low-traffic tenants we should default to global-signal fallback or require manual opt-in.
maria_sre: operational constraints: dry-run traffic must be isolated to prevent shared-cache contamination. tracing tag required (autoretire.cohort=<id>). Alert if error-rate delta > 2x baseline or latency p95 up > 25% for 30m. Also need a kill-switch per-tenant and a global abort.
sam_ops: from ops pov, prefer fixed cadence: 7d dry-run at 1% -> 48h at 10% -> final cut. Allow an admin hold to pause. We should also surface a simple UI with a one-click rollback to previous routing.
anna_pm: agree on cadence. For metrics let's start with bootstrap: require min 5000 calls in 14d window OR use global proxy. For stats test: two-sample proportion or bootstrapped median delta would be robust. propose default alpha=0.05 and min-absolute-delta=5% plus effect-size of 0.03.
ryan_eng: implementation sketch (short): autoretire-evaluator job runs nightly, computes per-tenant bucketed metrics, runs bootstrap; emits candidate if criteria met. MigrationPlan stored as record with phases. routing-layer consumes Phase flags via feature-gates. billing layer applies credits for flagged tenant during dry-run. Example config: ```json
{"scope":"tenant","min_calls":5000,"window_days":14,"stat_test":"bootstrap","alpha":0.05,"abs_delta":0.05,"effect_size":0.03,"phases":[{"name":"dryrun","pct":0.01,"days":7,"billing":"token_credit"},{"name":"ramp","pct":0.10,"hours":48,"billing":"invoice_credit"},{"name":"final_cut","pct":1.0,"hours":1,"billing":"none"}]}
```
kevin_csm: need explicit product policy: - enterprise contracts: require CS sign-off before any auto-dry-run. - self-serve: auto-dry-run unless opt-out in settings. - partner integrations: manual only. Also communications timeline: notice at T0, in-console banner, follow-up 7d, final 48h.
maria_sre: runbook hooks: - if dry-run causes >1% error increase overall, pause and page. - add synthetic traffic monitor for cohort during dry-run to validate routing. - metrics exported to per-tenant dashboard.
ryan_eng: dev list: 1) stats lib + evaluator 2) MigrationPlan schema + CRUD APIs 3) routing gate + tagging 4) billing shim for credit application 5) UI for opt-out + plan review 6) runbook automation. rough estimate: 4 sprints cross-team.
anna_pm: prioritization: label this "Q2-lowcost" since wins are maintenance reduction and fewer legacy backends. propose canary cohort of 120 tenants (mixed self-serve + low-touch enterprise) in Week of 2024-05-13. I'll draft PRD and include sample comms.
kevin_csm: I'll draft comm templates and tiered credit policy. Need clear FAQ for finance.
sam_ops: will prepare routing rollback tooling and reserve canary slot.
deploy-bot: Canary slot reserved 2024-05-14T09:00Z for cohort experiment.
anna_pm: cool. Action: I will post PRD + sample migration plan by Thu EOD and tag owners. Lock default thresholds as discussed unless data suggests change. :thumbsup:
ryan_eng: will spike stats lib and share prototype by next sync.
kevin_csm: :+1: prepping CS deck.
maria_sre: will start runbook draft and CI monitors.
anna_pm: closing thread 1
